name: Windows
title: ClipDiff for Windows
install: Download the self-contained ZIP from GitHub Releases; the runtime is included. Extract it and run ClipDiff.exe. Keep ClipDiff.ShellExtension.dll beside it.
The smaller net10 ZIP requires the x64 .NET 10 Desktop Runtime. To update, quit ClipDiff and extract to a new folder.
pathCopy: Use Copy as path in Explorer or copy a full path from your editor. One or two absolute Windows paths are accepted, one per line, optionally double-quoted.
fileNote: Text files up to 16 MiB are read. Binary or unusable files become a filename and reason. Windows .lnk targets are followed.

integration.setup: ClipDiff must already be running. On Windows 11, look under Show more options. No administrator setup is needed.
integration.single: Right-click a file after your first capture. The command includes the captured filename when available.
integration.pair: Select exactly two files; no prior capture is needed. The release DLL must be beside ClipDiff.exe.

viewers.discovery: Installed tools such as WinMerge, Beyond Compare and Meld should be detected automatically. Select yours under Diff viewer.
viewers.custom: Missing? Use Choose program... to select its executable. Custom tools must accept two file paths as arguments.

privacy.markers: ClipDiff honours Windows clipboard exclusions for monitoring, history and cloud clipboard.
